name: Ember newt
blurb: A walking heat source. It heats whatever it sits on: great on a boiler, bad news on grass.

name: Puddle frog
blurb: A spring on legs. Water pools around it and runs downhill.

name: Rime moth
blurb: Out from dusk to morning, it keeps everything next to it frozen. Ice stays ice; fires won't start.

name: Gale finch
blurb: Flaps a steady breeze in the direction you set. It spins windmills and herds steam.

name: Spark eel
blurb: Discharges every few seconds. In a pond, the whole pond gets the shock.

name: Burrow mole
blurb: Digs through rock, fills pits, or raises a pillar. Then it pops back into your satchel.
